integrity: Proof is an explicit finite-state reduction with exact local constraints and all-order path decomposition; direct small-order edge-subset enumeration is supporting verification. Claims of independent audit or validation are not made.
scientific_limitations: Only ordinary two-row open and cyclic Cartesian ladders; no Möbius closure or higher widths. General graph counting algorithms are known. Priority is not independently established; bibliographic uncertainty remains, especially for inaccessible older papers and the uninspected late sections of the closest 2026 source.
title: Periodic perfect-edge-domination rigidity on open and circular ladders
